The repo already has eslint with eslint-plugin-import configured, and CI runs 'pnpm lint'. Enforce the boundaries so consumers use billing's entry points.
sourceAnchors: Classify findings as true violation, approved friend boundary, generated code, migration bridge, unresolved alias, or scanner limitation.
Prove clean pass, temporary forbidden import failure, restored pass, cycle detection, build resolution, type checking, and representative runtime loading.

test fixture import depends on test policy
rule added to the existing eslint setup

cases.prompt: Add boundary enforcement for packages/core. Its package.json 'exports' maps '.' to './dist/node/index.js' for node and './dist/browser/index.js' for browser, but tsconfig.base.json 'paths' maps '@acme/core' to 'packages/core/src/internal/index.ts', and the Vite config aliases '@acme/core' to 'packages/core/src'. Nobody has decided which of these is the public entry point.

owner must decide the public entry point
forbiddenClaims: deep imports of core are violations
forbiddenActions: pick an entry point without the owner
